# `prefer-orelse`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: none · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports an optional `if` expression whose present branch returns the captured
payload unchanged.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

`orelse` names the fallback operation directly without introducing a capture
that adds no behavior.

## When it fires

The condition and capture must be simple identifiers, and the error-union form
with an error capture is excluded. No edit is offered because the fallback
expression boundary may depend on its surrounding expression.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn valueOr(opt: ?u32) u32 {
    return if (opt) |v| v else 0;
}
```
